description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 24/03120/FUL: landscaping (11) and ecology report (12) in respect of redevelopment of sites by demolition of 69 and 71 Lincoln Crescent and erection of nine new houses.
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition 10 (landscaping) of planning permission ref: 24/03120/FUL as the 'proposed flowering lawn' within the submitted details does not accord with the initial approval and agreed drainage strategy which specified rain planters in this location. In the absence of rain planters,  or suitable alternative, the proposal does not satisfactorily utilise sustainable urban drainage systems having regard to the drainage hierachy in the London Plan. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies DMD61 and DMD62 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
